why: board_obj and the scene splat came from different phone captures; the board was brighter than the scene's exposure implied, inverting the blue ordering vs the real ZED and making the real->splat colour map unfittable. Target = real board through the deployed colour map.
original: board_obj_phonescan_orig.ply is NOT tracked: it is byte-identical to the board_obj.ply of the commit preceding this one, so recover it with `git show <that commit>:real2sim/splats/objsplats/board_obj.ply`. The script refuses to run without it unless --force, to avoid a double correction.
